title: Central banks accelerate CBDC development in response to Bit
content: <div class="tldr-section"><em><strong>TL;DR: Central banks are accelerating their CBDC development, a clear defensive maneuver against Bitcoin's undeniable global adoption and the erosion of fiat trust. This push for centralized digital currencies highlights the critical importance of individual monetary sovereignty, making Bitcoin's robust, permissionless network — currently secured by a difficulty of 146.47 T and approximately 977 EH/s of hashpower — the essential bulwark against future financial control. For transactors, understanding these dynamics and optimizing Bitcoin usage is paramount to preserving
author: Al Ingle
